collect.comment: Lighthouse CI runs against the production build via `vite preview`. We can't use `staticDistDir` because the Vite build expects to be served under the `/astraudit/` base path — Lighthouse's bundled static server only serves at root. The preview command honours the base path, matching what GitHub Pages delivers.

assert.comment: Thresholds tuned to the May-2026 baseline. Performance floor is intentionally generous because the project ships a 5 MB `public/Logo_bg_removed.png` (per the maintainer's explicit decision); the LCP element that drags us to ~0.78. Phase 4.4 will further reduce the JS bundle. Accessibility is held high because Phase 2.8.7 + 4.2 paid that bill — every audit hit a perfect 1.0 once light-theme contrast was fixed.
